performanceTooltip.purpose: Mobile selected-day metrics and all publication titles remain accessible in the persistent month/day inspector.

analysisWorkspace.purpose: Channel-detail KPI strip without icons, full-width chart and persistent selected-day post inspector. Connected channels appear first; unavailable AI has one compact explanation. The overview instead uses channel cards and a full-image introduction.

photographicIntro.purpose: Shared approved full-image editorial header across all analysis pages, including channel details and Video Performance. Uses the overview title scale and gradient; supersedes the split photograph and blue text surface.
photographicIntro.descriptionPlacement: Channel-specific description under the title inside the image header, retained on mobile.

channelLogos.contextTile: white surface, 1px #e6eaf0 border, 8px radius and padding
channelLogos.purpose: Provider SVGs accompany text labels; event and QR channels retain line icons.

multiMetricChart.relativeScale: Each month/metric series peaks at 100%; tooltips and day inspector retain absolute values.
multiMetricChart.purpose: Stable field colors identify metrics; line patterns identify months.
multiMetricChart.monthSelection: Base-month input and compact month comparison disclosure with selection count, checkboxes and optional custom month; the base month remains selected.
multiMetricChart.postTooltip: Real main image when available, full title, impressions and clicks since publication, explicitly labelled Seit Veröffentlichung. Missing images have a text fallback. Daily channel metrics remain separate.

overviewIntro.title: MARKETING PERFORMANCE & INSIGHT
overviewIntro.purpose: Full-image overview header with white title, followed by the agent introduction. The context row shows the current reporting month without a month input and refresh beside the connected-channel count; monthly detail views retain month selection; LinkedIn Ads uses its independent rolling 365-day window.

channelOverview.purpose: All channels remain visible as buttons with a logo or icon, status, up to three KPI slots and data context. Empty channels explain unavailable data. Selecting a channel opens its retained deep dive; the overview contains no separate KPI strip or chart.

overviewRecommendations.currentMonth: Public reporting timezone, Europe/Zurich fallback; recalculated every minute.
overviewRecommendations.emptyState: Three non-interactive graphical preview cards, explicitly captioned Grafische Vorschau · Noch keine datenbasierte Auswertung. No fabricated findings, measurements or setup alerts; preview is intentional while AI is unconfigured.

videoPerformance.purpose: Separate LinkedIn video-only post collection and YouTube monthly summary or explicit pending state. Reuses the shared full-image header and refresh toolbar and content-area month selector; does not combine platform totals or establish a YouTube connection. Administrative navigation is unchanged.

detailToolbar.placement: Refresh controls below the shared photographic header, without a month selector. Monthly channels select the base month inside the performance workspace; videos, audience, posts, insights and reports select their month in the content area. LinkedIn Ads retains its independent rolling window.

adsCampaigns.purpose: Compact image-led campaign rows with real title, objective, status, planned runtime and six metrics: impressions, clicks, spend, CTR, CPC and conversions. Older metadata remains visible; metrics use the rolling last 365 days independently of the reporting month. No search, monthly controls or campaign comparisons. CSV metric selection exports the real list; objective-specific disclosures are fixed reading guidance, not AI recommendations. Reuses the approved photographic header, blue palette and Red Hat Display.
adsCampaigns.images: Real API-provided campaign image; unavailable or failed images use a text fallback.
adsCampaigns.example: Append one explicitly fictitious presentation-only example in the live view when fewer than two real campaigns have metrics. Exclude it from counts, CSV exports and analysis.

postCollection.defaultSort: Publication date ascending; optional metric sorts descending.
postCollection.images: Real main images only, object-fit contain; missing or failed images use text fallback.
postCollection.timeBasis: Post totals since publication, with retrieval context; not daily or monthly values.

kpiExplainer.label: KPI erklärt
kpiExplainer.control: Native select with visible label and a polite live region for the selected explanation.
kpiExplainer.placement: Channel definitions, Ads, post collections and video views; options use the metrics relevant to each view.
kpiExplainer.purpose: Explain one metric at a time while preserving channel-specific meaning, units and caveats.

mailingGroups.disclosure: Native details/summary, initially expanded; pale blue headings and a primary-blue top border over white mailing rows.
mailingGroups.compactLayout: 46px date column, 112px image column and flexible copy; five metrics below the copy.
mailingGroups.filters: Month, content type and title/subject/topic search; current Europe/Zurich month is initially selected and listed first, whole-year option last. Month selects whole groups and keeps related sendings visible with an explicit explanation.
mailingGroups.dataContext: Title/subject-derived grouping is labelled; unclear assignments remain separate. Language variants and repeat sendings retain separate rows, tests/templates are excluded. Five immediately visible metrics with missing values shown as a dash; event-registration attribution deferred, existing grouping retained.
mailingGroups.mobileLayout: Date spans the row; 80px image and flexible copy columns; metrics below the copy.
mailingGroups.images: Actual lead images from mailing content; object-fit contain, 112px by 76px on desktop and 80px wide on mobile. Text fallback when unavailable.
mailingGroups.order: Groups by latest mailing descending; mailings within each group by send date descending.
mailingGroups.metricLayout: Three-column grid with 12px row gaps; rates include percent suffix only for known values.
mailingGroups.detailDisclosure: Native details labelled Zustellung & Abmeldungen reveals delivered messages, hard/soft bounces, unsubscribe count/rate and open rate. Spans the row at 600px and below; opening caveat remains visible inside.
mailingGroups.metricDefinitions: Shared KPI explainer covers all inline and disclosure metrics.

narrative.overview:
This document records the implemented interface in `frontend/src/styles.css`, `frontend/src/App.tsx`, and `frontend/src/components/ui.tsx`. It uses a white navigation sidebar, a light grey canvas, bordered white panels, and blue primary controls. Red Hat Display is used throughout; the original Sonio logo and arrow assets are served from `frontend/public/brand/`.

This record replaces the provisional plan written during the same implementation. It adds no creative metaphor or brand claims. The frontmatter records reusable values, with component-specific extensions in `.impeccable/design.json`. The application canvas follows the extracted `canvas` token.
keyCharacteristics: White panels separated by borders on a light grey canvas.

Shared full-image introductions across analysis pages and eight overview channel cards; separate subpage controls, compact blue video cards, white channel-detail KPI strips, and pale blue export controls.
Left-aligned labels and tabular metric numerals.
Text labels alongside data status, comparison, and priority indicators.
Responsive grids, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion support.
dos: **Do** reuse the original Sonio logo, arrow assets, and self-hosted Red Hat Display font.
**Do** use the implemented primary, neutral, border, radius, and control tokens.
**Do** keep status and priority meanings available in text alongside color and icons.
**Do** preserve visible keyboard focus, modal and mobile navigation behavior, and reduced-motion support.
**Do** label demonstration data and preserve missing values and fractional measurements.
donts: **Don't** present demonstration values as live measurements.
**Don't** replace missing metrics with fabricated zeroes.
**Don't** show administrator-only editing workflows to viewers.
**Don't** remove explanation, evidence, and caveats from recommendation details.
